## PR Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the coding style guidelines in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] All external URLs and endpoints are declared in `src/services/endpoints.ts` (no hardcoded URLs).
- [ ] I have run `npm run check` locally with zero TypeScript errors or ESLint warnings.
- [ ] I have run `npm run test` and all unit/integration tests pass.
- [ ] For new widgets, I have included a corresponding `*.stories.tsx` Storybook story.
- [ ] For new templates, all personal data (private links, bio, avatars) has been scrubbed from the JSON.
- [ ] My commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format.
